text: Here's another message from a subscriber who found himself in a toxic relationship, got a tough response from me, and found the courage to get out of it. Hello sir, I would love to hear a suggestion or tips on what to do in my current situation with my partner, since I don't have someone to talk to about this or guide me with. We are a couple for almost two years, but since the year 2025 started, things started to change. The things that she and I used to do suddenly became cringe to her, such as posting each other, taking a picture, being sweet to each other, and many more normal things that a couple does. I didn't treat her badly, nor did things that will make our relationship fall off. Not to mention, she has a celebrity who is always on her DMs. Things get rough, dry, and suddenly felt like there is no love anymore, as if I'm the only one who is keeping us together. She doesn't want to break up with me, and I don't know why. I hope you'll give me recommendations, sir, being a fan of you ever since I watched your video on my FYP. So this is what I wrote. Hey man, if your girlfriend thinks doing a couple things that you used to do is cringe, gets male validation on the side, emotionally cheats with some celebrity, you break up. Do not wait until she does it. Remember, relationships should be light and easygoing. If you are still in this relationship and even wondering how to make them work, you lack boundaries and self-respect. You need to start working on every aspect of your life, career, hobbies, fitness, dating. Start having right principles, one of which is self-respect is paramount. He writes, thank you so much, sir, and I also add another empirical thing comes from experience. One of the main signs that your girl is cheating on you is change in behavior. So if from certain point of time she suddenly started acting differently, there is a chance that she started cheating on you. Well, if she talks to other guys behind your back, for example, if some celebrity sends her DMs, she probably responds to them, that can already be considered emotional cheating. But I wouldn't be surprised if there's also physical cheating. Anyways, that is what I can think of based on what you wrote, you decide what to do with it. He wrote, okay, sir, I'll think about it. And then after around two weeks, I got another message from him. Hello, sir, just to update you, I broke up with her last week because she won't ever let me see her tablet due to some personal reasons she doesn't want to tell me. And she told me that her parents and cousins don't like me and started bad mouthing me where she got influenced by not liking me too. Too bad that I'm always there and ready to save our relationship and there she was trying to save herself. Anyways, I'm feeling good now that our relationship has ended. Thanks for your advice, sir. Not entirely sure if she's talking with other guys or not. Well, it's not that important. And I wrote to him better late than never. I'm glad you did break up. Try to follow the advice from this video. And I believe I attached a video on how to forget your ex. But I really hope you don't get back with her, that you will start working on yourself and that your life is actually will get better. Thanks a lot and bye.
